name: claude-mods
description: Personal Claude Code mods, forked from upstream with local fixes.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Context window forecast above the prompt, with a prompt-cache countdown, cold-since time, cache hit/miss stats and a cost row (session and turn cost, turn time, t/s, thinking tokens). Fork of hamzafer/claude-code-mods.

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: IDE-style file tree pane for Claude Code. Fork of data-goblin/claude-code-filetree.
